extensionDescription.message: Universal Pegboard — pin once, call anywhere. Compact popup plus in-page detectors and a selector adapter on the sites you enable.

endpointPermissionDenied.message: Access to that endpoint was denied — allow it to save the endpoint.

endpointErrorNotUrl.message: Enter a URL or host:port, for example http://127.0.0.1:7173.

endpointErrorNotHttp.message: Only http:// endpoints are supported for the local host.

endpointErrorCredentials.message: Remove the user:password@ part — the endpoint is just host and port.

endpointErrorPath.message: Remove the path or query — the endpoint is just the server address, for example http://127.0.0.1:7173.

endpointErrorNotLoopback.message: For your security the endpoint must be on this device — 127.0.0.1, localhost, or ::1.

endpointErrorPort.message: The port must be a number between 1 and 65535.

pairingHelp.message: Run `upeg http status --pairing` to print the running host's URL and token, then paste them here.

runHint.message: Not running? Start it with: $COMMAND$, then run $PAIRING$ to see the host URL and token to enter in Settings.

tokenRejected.message: upeg rejected this token — check it and save again.

tokenRequired.message: upeg requires a token — add it below.

noBoardsFound.message: No boards found — pin a tool to a board first.

boardLoadFailed.message: Could not load this board — try another tab.

boardEmpty.message: No pinned tools on this board yet.

tokenSavedStatus.message: Token saved. Paste a new one to replace it.

tokenMissingStatus.message: No token saved — required if upeg enforces auth.

jsonFieldNote.message: No dedicated control for this field — enter a JSON value.

fileTooMany.message: "$FIELD$" accepts at most $LIMIT$ files; $ACTUAL$ were selected.

fileTooManyNodes.message: "$FIELD$" produces $ACTUAL$ file nodes; the limit is $LIMIT$.

fileExtensionNotAllowed.message: "$FILE$" is not an allowed file type. Expected: $EXTENSIONS$.

fileTooLarge.message: "$FILE$" is $ACTUAL$ bytes; the per-file limit is $LIMIT$ bytes.

fileTotalTooLarge.message: "$FIELD$" totals $ACTUAL$ bytes; the policy limit is $LIMIT$ bytes.

fileTransportTooLarge.message: "$FIELD$" totals $ACTUAL$ bytes; the extension transport limit is $LIMIT$ bytes.

fileMetadataTooLarge.message: "$FIELD$" file names and MIME types total $ACTUAL$ UTF-8 bytes; the limit is $LIMIT$ bytes.

fileReadTooLarge.message: "$FILE$" exceeded the $LIMIT$-byte limit while being read.

fileReadSizeMismatch.message: "$FILE$" changed size while being read. Select it again.

fileReadFailed.message: Could not read "$FIELD$". Select the files again.

fileOutputTooLarge.message: The File output is $ACTUAL$ bytes; this popup can download up to $LIMIT$ bytes.

hostUnavailable.message: upeg is not serving requests right now.

requestBodyTooLarge.message: The request is $ACTUAL$ UTF-8 bytes; it must be smaller than $LIMIT$ bytes.

inPageUnreachable.message: This tab has no upeg content script — reload it and try again.

inPageTriggered.message: Filled $COUNT$ page field(s) and fired the trigger.

siteToggleTitle.message: Run upeg's in-page tools on this site

siteUnsupported.message: upeg cannot run inside this page.

siteDenied.message: Chrome denied access to this site.

siteEnabledNeedsReload.message: Enabled on $SITE$ — reload the page to start.

siteDisabled.message: Disabled on $SITE$ — reload the page to clear it.
